messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Dedicated pool `orion-eu-west-1` (tenant: Orion Finance) p99 latency spike detected. Current p99 = 2.1s (SLO 500ms). Error rate stable. Autoscale did not trigger due to reserved capacity limit. Incident created: 1793500123 

alice_sre: ack, I'm on it. paging ben and elena. starting war-room.

ben_oncall: joining — looking at traces. seeing long tail at model-host gpu-03, KV cache misses up ~8x. suspect cache eviction on large concurrent prefixes.

elena_dedicated: oncall for Dedicated here. confirming: this is the Orion reserved pool, isolated VPC. No cross-tenant noisy neighbor flagged yet. I'll check node metrics.

carla_platform: created war-room: https://warroom.internal/redwood/1793500123 — add notes. Dan from account team looped in for customer comms.

dan_acct: pinged Orion SE, they're seeing degraded p95 in their dashboards too. They want ETA. I'll hold quick customer-focused note.

ben_oncall: quick mitigation options: 1) failover traffic to orion-eu-backup region 2) increase pool size (if available) 3) enable per-request KV caching warmup/disabled eviction policy 4) throttle non-critical background jobs. prefer 2 + 3 for shortest customer impact.

elena_dedicated: checking pool headroom: reserved pool has 1 spare node but scaling requires manual approval for reserved customers. I can trigger a short burst from shared spare capacity if SRE approves.

alice_sre: SRE approves burst. elena, proceed with scale + temporarily relax eviction. Ben, can you prepare a config patch for lowering prefix eviction threshold?

ben_oncall: patch ready. Pushing config to orion-eu-west-1: 
```bash
rpool scale --pool orion-eu-west-1 --add-nodes 1 --mode burst
rconf set --pool orion-eu-west-1 --kv-eviction-threshold 0.6
```

infra-bot: Action started: rpool scale request accepted. Job ID: job-67431. Estimated ready in ~90s.

ben_oncall: applying KV config now. rolling restart on model-hosts with zero-downtime handoff.

elena_dedicated: scale complete. new node joined pool. KV eviction threshold set to 0.6. Draining non-Orion tenants from gpu-03 to reduce noise (moving 4 small tenants).

infra-bot: Job job-67431 completed. Nodes added: gpu-07. Drains begun on gpu-03.

alice_sre: p99 dropping — current p99 = 800ms. Keep monitoring. Ben, any further changes?

ben_oncall: still a small tail caused by long-context requests. Enabling reduced-batching mode for Orion to favor latency over throughput. Command: 
```json
{"tenant":"orion","batching":"reduced","max_batch_size":4}
```

carla_platform: routing policy updated to prefer local cache hits. Canary rollback path in place.

dan_acct: Orion is on the call, they confirm improvement on their end. Asking for ETA to full recovery.

elena_dedicated: based on current trend, expect p99 < 500ms in 6-8min as KV warms and drained tenants fully shifted.

alice_sre: noted. handing off monitoring to ben for night watch. I will write interim customer note and postmortem ticket.

ben_oncall: I got it. I'll keep alerting thresholds lowered and will escalate if p99 > 700ms for 5 minutes.

dan_acct: sent note to Orion: "We've applied burst capacity and cache tuning; you're seeing improvements. We'll follow up with a remediation plan and postmortem." They replied :thumbsup:.

infra-bot: Autoscaling metric: pool_util 65% -> 45% after scale & drain. KV miss rate down 73% -> 12%.

alice_sre: final status check — p99 = 420ms, p95 = 110ms, error rate normal. Marking incident as mitigated. Creating postmortem draft and assigning to elena (owner) + ben (SRE) + alice (ops).

elena_dedicated: I'll own the remediation: investigate eviction tuning defaults for reserved pools and add auto-burst policy for enterprise contracts.

ben_oncall: will add telemetry dashboards for per-tenant KV miss rate and a runbook for manual bursts.

carla_platform: scheduling postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:00 UTC. war-room will remain open until then.

alice_sre: handoff — ben taking on-call for follow-up. I'll sign out. Great coordination everyone. Closing war-room notes and tagging for postmortem.

dan_acct: I'll send a follow-up summary to the customer with next steps and timelines.

IncidentBot: Incident 1793500123 mitigated. Severity: Sev2. Duration: ~13m. Actions: burst scale, KV eviction tuning, tenant drains, reduced batching. Postmortem assigned.
